const implementation = class { x = 1; y = 2; constructor(input: number | string) {} };
const mismatched: { new(value: number): { x: number }; new(value: string): { y: number } } = implementation;
class First extends mismatched {}

type NumericBase = { new(value: number): { x: number } };
type TextualBase = { new(value: string): { x: number; y?: number } };
const intersected: NumericBase & TextualBase = implementation;
class Second extends intersected {}

const reordered: { new(value: number): { nested: { value: number } }; new(value: string): { nested: { value: any } } } =
  class { nested = { value: 1 }; constructor(input: number | string) {} };
class Third extends reordered {}

const readonlyBase: { new(value: number): { x: number }; new(value: string): { readonly x: number } } = implementation;
class Fourth extends readonlyBase {}
